room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction on associated medical expenses if higher room chosen; not applied where hospital doesn't follow differential billing

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges all-inclusive as provided by hospital

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-payment on every admissible claim; optional waiver available on payment of additional premium

sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at ₹40,000 per eye per policy year; modern treatments capped at 50% of sum insured

initial_waiting.note: 90-day waiting period applies for HIV/AIDS benefit basis cover

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting: 36 months for general diseases, 24 months for pre-existing disability, 90 days for HIV/AIDS

specific_disease_waiting.note: Covers cataract, ENT, thyroid, hernia, joint replacements, gallbladder, kidney stones, gynaec conditions, varicose veins, and many others

maternity.note: Maternity explicitly excluded under Code Excl 18; ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

domiciliary.note: No domiciliary treatment benefit mentioned in the policy wording

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment under Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homeopathy covered up to 100% of sum insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: No organ donor expense benefit mentioned in the policy wording

modern_treatments.note: Covers robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, deep brain stimulation, HIFU, balloon sinuplasty, intravitreal injections, bronchial thermoplasty, green/holmium laser prostate, IONM, stem cell therapy for haematological conditions

consumables.note: Consumables listed in List I are excluded; items in Lists II-IV subsumed into room/procedure/treatment charges

global_cover.note: Territorial limit: all treatments must be taken in India

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, no claim contestable except fraud and permanent exclusions

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not on renewals or portability/migration

notable_exclusions: Maternity, sterility/infertility, dental (unless accident), venereal disease (except HIV), circumcision, congenital external anomalies, obesity surgery (unless criteria met), erectile dysfunction
optional_riders: Waiver of 20% co-payment (available on additional premium)
